glosses: обносить забором (оградой), отгораживать; перен. выделять, отделять
To enclose an area within a fence.

examples.text: The cutting is fenced off from the main line at the Clifton end, and is, therefore, not observed from main line trains.
Fenced off from the rest of the island, the Foreign Colony is little more than an American suburb with exotic foliage.
